description: Add a comprehensive unit and user-flow test suite to Focus Guard using Vitest. All external systems (Chrome extension APIs, WebAuthn/navigator.credentials, DOM) are mocked. No integration tests. Includes a GitHub Actions CI workflow to run tests on every push and pull request.

userStories.title: Test infrastructure setup
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a Vitest configuration and shared Chrome API mock utilities so that all other test stories have a consistent foundation to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: `vitest` is added as a dev dependency (via `package.json`)
`vitest.config.js` is created at the project root with `environment: 'jsdom'` and an alias so `import ... from 'lib/...'` resolves correctly

A shared mock helper (e.g. `tests/helpers/chrome-mock.js`) exports a `setupChromeMock()` function that stubs the full `chrome` global: `chrome.storage.local`, `chrome.runtime`, `chrome.declarativeNetRequest`, `chrome.alarms`, and `chrome.tabs`
`npm test` runs the full suite successfully
A `tests/` directory structure is established: `tests/unit/` for lib tests, `tests/flows/` for user flow tests

userStories.title: User flow tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a suite of end-to-end user flow tests (all within a single test file) that exercise complete user journeys through the JS modules with all external services mocked, so that the most critical paths are verified holistically.
acceptanceCriteria: Test file at `tests/flows/user-flows.test.js`
All chrome APIs and WebAuthn mocked; real `lib/` and service worker logic exercised
Flow 1 — Register a security key: user opens popup → triggers registration → credential is saved to storage with correct shape and only hardware transports
Flow 2 — Add a domain to blocklist: user submits domain in popup → normalized domain appears in blocklist in storage → block rule exists in mocked declarativeNetRequest
Flow 3 — Remove a domain from blocklist: user removes domain → domain absent from blocklist → block rule removed from declarativeNetRequest
Flow 4 — Unlock a blocked site: user on blocked page triggers WebAuthn assertion (mocked success) → service worker verifies → allow rule created → unlock record written to storage → alarm set
Flow 5 — Unlock expiry re-locks domain: alarm fires for a previously unlocked domain → allow rule removed → unlock record cleared from storage
Flow 6 — Remove a registered security key: user removes key → credential cleared from storage → subsequent unlock attempts fail
Flow 7 — Configure unlock duration: user sets duration to 60 minutes → next unlock flow uses 60-minute expiry
All tests pass

userStories.title: GitHub Actions CI
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a GitHub Actions workflow that runs the full test suite on every push and pull request so that regressions are caught automatically.

Uses Node.js LTS (22.x)
Runs `npm ci` then `npm test`
Workflow passes on a clean run of the test suite
